title: The strategy a session chose is posted as a coord event and shown once to the other session, so both know who waits for whom
goal: coord.py post --kind coordinate takes the fields item, other, strategy (wait / ask / after / join / proceed), touch, session and operator and refuses a missing item, other or strategy, any other field and any other strategy with exit 2; kbask.py coordinate ITEM OTHER STRATEGY posts it for the session that chose, the live session whose intent names ITEM, with the operator id kbwho gives; when announce.to_other_sessions is true the coord hook shows it once, at the next SessionStart, Bash, Skill, Edit or Write event of the session that holds OTHER, not paced by the 10 second interval of the asks; the line names the chooser by its label and operator id, the strategy as a verb phrase (will wait / will ask / will go after / will join / will proceed) with OTHER plus the touch files, for example: session s-xxxxxx of operator ID, working on ITEM, will wait for your landing of OTHER before editing FILES; kbmon's log panel and --events show it as coord.coordinate

clauses.clause: coord.py post --kind coordinate takes the fields item, other, strategy (wait / ask / after / join / proceed), touch, session and operator and refuses a missing item, other or strategy, any other field and any other strategy with exit 2
kbask.py coordinate ITEM OTHER STRATEGY posts it for the session that chose, the live session whose intent names ITEM, with the operator id kbwho gives

when announce.to_other_sessions is true the coord hook shows it once, at the next SessionStart, Bash, Skill, Edit or Write event of the session that holds OTHER, not paced by the 10 second interval of the asks

the line names the chooser by its label and operator id, the strategy as a verb phrase (will wait / will ask / will go after / will join / will proceed) with OTHER plus the touch files, for example: session s-xxxxxx of operator ID, working on ITEM, will wait for your landing of OTHER before editing FILES
kbmon's log panel and --events show it as coord.coordinate

gates.question: Which touch files does kbask.py coordinate post, and which session counts as the chooser?
options: touch = the chooser's intent paths that the intents naming OTHER also list (left out when none); chooser = the newest live session intent naming ITEM, a backlog-claim intent only when no other exists
touch = all of the chooser's intent paths; chooser = any live intent naming ITEM
gates.recommendation: touch = the chooser's intent paths that the intents naming OTHER also list (left out when none); chooser = the newest live session intent naming ITEM, a backlog-claim intent only when no other exists

gates.question: How does the coord hook show coordinate events: read at every event, first look limit and line cap?
options: one unpaced coord.py wait --kind coordinate per tool event with a state cursor; a first look leaves out events older than an hour; at most 3 lines and a count line; phrases will wait for your landing of / will ask you about / will go after / will join your work on / will proceed alongside
read the events with the asks' paced read (every 10 seconds), no age limit, one line each
gates.recommendation: one unpaced coord.py wait --kind coordinate per tool event with a state cursor; a first look leaves out events older than an hour; at most 3 lines and a count line; phrases will wait for your landing of / will ask you about / will go after / will join your work on / will proceed alongside
